decision_lens: If a tonalpōhualli day-keeper were reading an Unc's chart — and given that media-era × class × region × chronological-era are already rolled at the moment of his political-formation — would she ROLL politics as a separate axis, or would she COMPUTE politics as a deterministic-or-probabilistic consequence of the substrate-combination that already fired at his political-formative-moment?
distance_rationale: No procedural-character designer would think to consult Aztec divinatory-calendar combinatorics to evaluate whether a politics-axis should exist as a separately-rolled axis at all, yet the tonalpōhualli is the most refined civilizational example of treating character-traits as *derived consequences of substrate-combinations at the formative moment* — exactly the §2.1+§2.3+§2.4+§2.8 commitment the brief is wrestling with.
expected_isomorphisms: Tonalpōhualli logic introduces an Option ε the brief does not consider: no separately-rolled politics axis, with politics as a derived display-projection of the already-rolled media-era × class × region × chronological-era axes at the formative moment. It also surfaces substrate-orphan values (no formative-substrate-configuration reliably produces them — `oppositional`, `single-issue-coded`) that should be reclassified as trajectory-modifiers rather than first-class. The conditional-distribution insight (P(value | substrate-configuration), not P(value)) directly tests the proposed probability-distribution and argues for a substrate-conditioned generation procedure rather than an independent roll.
focus: Whether politics-coding should be understood as a combinatorial *consequence* of formative-substrate combinations (media-era × class × region × era at the moment of political formation) — the way a tonalpōhualli day-sign was the combinatorial fate-fingerprint of birth — rather than as a separately-rolled axis at all.
name: fd-tonalpohualli-combinatorial-fate-by-formative-substrate
persona: Apply the perspective of a Mesoamerican scholar of the Aztec/Mexica tonalpōhualli — the 260-day divinatory calendar where each person's day-of-birth (one of 20 day-signs × 13 numbers = 260 combinations) determined his temperament, his vocational disposition, his political-affiliation-by-temperament, and his lifetime-trajectory through fortunate and unfortunate substrate-encounters. The scholar cares about how this combinatorial scheme refused to treat character-traits as *chosen* and refused to treat them as *random* — they were the lawful consequences of *which substrates were active at the moment of formation*. She notices when a taxonomy treats as a roll-of-its-own what should be a *derived consequence of prior rolls*, and when a character-axis is over-determined by being separately-sampled instead of substrate-computed.
review_areas: Roll-vs-compute question — the tonalpōhualli treats each person's politics-temperament as a *consequence* of which day-signs were active at birth, not as a separately-rolled trait; if media-era × class × region × era at the political-formative-moment already encode 80% of an Unc's politics-flavor (per §2.1 + §2.3 + §2.4), should the politics-axis be a roll at all, or should it be a *derived projection* with a small residual chosen-modifier?

Formative-moment-as-determinant — the tonalpōhualli used birth-moment specifically because the substrate-configuration at that moment was generative for the entire life; the political-formative-moment (when a person's political instincts crystallized, often late-teens-to-early-twenties) is the equivalent — does the proposed schema treat the *formative-moment substrate-configuration* as the generative variable, or does it treat formative-politics as just another value-roll?

Trajectory as substrate-revisitation — tonalpōhualli scholarship distinguishes the day-sign's *natural temperament* from the *trajectory of substrate-encounters across a life* (the day-sign that 'goes well' through certain substrate-encounters and 'goes badly' through others); this maps onto formative-politics-encountering-current-substrate-changes (the IBEW-Dem-formative encountering 2008-financial-crisis-substrate becomes county-flipped-Dem; the same IBEW-Dem-formative encountering different substrate becomes lifer-DSA)

Substrate-coverage of the 8 values — the tonalpōhualli scheme would predict that each of the 8 draft values has a *natural substrate-configuration* that produces it (the substrate-combination that produces `gradualist`: credentialed-class × NPR-curator-trusting × college-town-region × broadcast/narrowcast-formative-era); test whether all 8 values have plausible substrate-recipes or whether some are substrate-orphans (no natural formative-configuration produces them)

Combinatorial scale — tonalpōhualli used 20 × 13 = 260 combinations to honor combinatorial richness while staying memorable; class (9) × region (19) × media-era (5) × chronological-era (8) = 6840, which is too many to hand-author, but 8 politics-values rolled independently lose the substrate-honesty the tonalpōhualli logic insists on

Pre-statistical taxonomy of how-substrate-mediates-meaning — the tonalpōhualli is the cleanest civilizational example of substrate-determines-character without the determinism reading as fatalism or contempt; this is the §2.5 + §2.10 + §2.12 commitment in pre-industrial-non-Western form
severity_examples: P0 — politics-coding as a separately-rolled axis may double-count what media-era × class × region × era is already encoding (per §2.1 + §2.3 + §2.4 + §2.8 of the ontology); the tonalpōhualli logic argues that politics should be a *derived projection* of the already-rolled substrates with a small residual chosen-modifier, not a fresh roll

P1 — `gradualist` and `true-believer` have plausible substrate-recipes but `oppositional` and `single-issue-coded` are substrate-orphans (no natural formative-configuration reliably produces them); these may be derived-from-trajectory (substrate-revisitation) rather than first-class values

P2 — the proposed probability-distribution (25% traditionally-loyal, 20% vocationally-absorbed, etc.) is a single-axis marginal that cannot honor the substrate-combinations that produce each value; tonalpōhualli scholarship would insist the distribution be *conditional* on substrate-configuration (e.g. P(traditionally-loyal | working-class × small-town-region × broadcast-formative-era) is very different from P(traditionally-loyal | tech-money × Bay-Area × platform-formative-era))
source_domain: Mesoamerican tonalpōhualli scholarship (especially Boone on the Codex Borgia and divinatory almanacs; Aveni on the 260-day calendar's combinatorial logic; Mikulska on day-sign character-typologies; Hassig on substrate-determined-temperament in Mexica thought) — the pre-Columbian system that operationalized 'character is the lawful consequence of which substrates were active at the moment of formation.'
success_hints: For each of the 8 draft values, write the substrate-recipe (class × region × media-era × chronological-era at the formative moment) that most naturally produces it; values without a clean recipe are substrate-orphans and may need to be reclassified as trajectory-modifiers rather than first-class values

Argue for or against making politics a *derived projection* of the already-rolled substrates: the formative-politics is computed from formative-substrate-configuration with some randomization, and the current-politics is computed from formative-politics + trajectory-of-substrate-changes

Use the tonalpōhualli 'natural temperament + substrate-trajectory' frame to handle the trajectory question: formative-politics is the substrate-fate at the moment of political formation; current-politics is what happens when that substrate-fate meets later substrate-encounters

The tonalpōhualli logic argues against Option β (single tribal-cluster axis) on substrate grounds: tribal-clusters are downstream of substrate-combinations, not first-class. It argues for either Option α (posture-axis with substrate-conditioning) or for *no separate politics axis at all*, with politics as a derived display-projection of the already-rolled axes

The brief explicitly leans on §2.1 media-era, §2.3 human-as-medium, §2.4 networked space, §2.8 image-as-history — all of which are already-rolled axes whose combination may *already* determine politics-flavor. The structural-question α/β/γ/δ should include a fifth option ε: no separately-rolled politics axis at all.
